title: Benjamin Marsh
summary: A rogue operative named by Compromised as part of the Gulf Coast network tied to Keener associates.

claims.text: Compromised has ISAC identify Benjamin Marsh as a rogue agent during the Marsh Island arms rendezvous.
The novel's ISAC identification lists Aaron Keener, Javier Kajika and Theo Parnell as Benjamin Marsh's known associates.
Marsh is killed during the Marsh Island rendezvous after betraying Cassandra Raines and the Reborn operatives present there.

paragraphs.text: Marsh is the novel's named link between the Gulf Coast operation and a known-associates list containing Keener, Kajika and Parnell. The record does not infer a broader hierarchy beyond that listed association.
The arms rendezvous ends with Marsh turning on the Reborn and then dying in the same confrontation, exposing the network's use of the faction.

verification.notes: Association wording is restricted to the ISAC list presented by the licensed novel; it does not claim that Marsh is one of the four Warlords targets.
